repository_rules: At least two distinct application domains and two language/toolchain families
Repository has deterministic checkout, license permission, documented build/test commands, and an offline-capable dependency snapshot
At least one repository must have meaningful structural validation; N/A is allowed elsewhere
No Continufy or any named component is required
inclusion: Realistic change with frozen intent, independently reviewed acceptance oracle, known starting commit, and both focused and repository gates
Pilot calibration by non-study tasks places task in moderate or difficult band using file/module reach, acceptance clauses, and blinded expert estimates
Task can be attempted in both conditions without changing requirements or environment
Implementation is substantively required; preserve tasks forecast to remain implementation-difficult
exclusion: Requirements cannot be made determinate before randomization
Repository cannot be reproduced in the frozen environment
Task was used to tune the assigned AI system or is already present in its session context
allocation: Freeze all 64 templates and strata, then computer-randomize condition order and operator using a committed seed. Both conditions execute every template from reset commits.
substitution: No post-outcome substitution. Pre-randomization replacements require a versioned amendment and same stratum; post-randomization ineligibility is retained and classified/excluded only by frozen rules.
preservation: All failures, null effects, implementation-dominant cases, and valid negative results remain in analysis. Report repository/task/difficulty strata individually before aggregation.
